turnaround_reason: Sarepta was hammered through 2025 by patient deaths tied to gene therapy, a November 2025 ELEVIDYS boxed warning for acute liver injury, and removal of the non-ambulatory indication, which gutted the growth story and sent revenue down ~34% YoY. The stock is recovering (+43% over 30d) on stabilizing commercial execution and a catalyst-rich 2026-27 pipeline.
bullish_points: Commercial portfolio stabilizing: Q2 2026 EPS $0.64 beat $0.49 est by 32%; legacy exon-skippers (Amondys/Vyondys) expected to sustain ~$400M revenue
FDA accepted sNDAs to convert Amondys 45 and Vyondys 53 to traditional approval, PDUFA 2026-02-28 (removes accelerated-approval overhang)
Meaningful insider buying signal: net +883k shares purchased over 6m (though largely equity grants, incl. a 756k CEO award)
Partnered siRNA programs (FSHD, myotonic dystrophy type 1) with H2 data as potential catalysts; Roche and Arrowhead collaborations de-risk funding
Cheap on forward earnings (forward P/E ~8.8) with a >4.4 current ratio and ~$788M cash for a de-risked balance sheet
bearish_points: ELEVIDYS safety overhang is not resolved — boxed warning and lost non-ambulatory indication cap the franchise until the ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 sirolimus data reads out, and the safety study slipped ~5 months
Revenue down 34% YoY and profit margin negative (-6.9%); the 'return to growth' is a company assertion, not yet a result
Gene therapy mortality history is an existential tail risk for a name whose valuation rests on ELEVIDYS
Sampled options open interest is very thin (29 calls / 45 puts) despite listed expiries — execution/liquidity risk for options
Binary, headline-driven equity: high 87% IV means the market is pricing large moves both ways
catalyst: PDUFA decision on Amondys/Vyondys traditional conversion; ELEVIDYS return-to-growth trajectory; H2 siRNA (FSHD/DM1) partnered data
catalyst_timing: PDUFA 2026-02-28; siRNA data H2 2026; next earnings 2026-11-04
suggested_trade: Spot starter position; size small given binary risk. Avoid options given thin OI and 87% IV bleed
key_risk: New ELEVIDYS safety signal (or a negative ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 readout) reignites the mortality narrative and collapses the franchise
would_skip_if: Any new gene-therapy safety event, a PDUFA delay/CRL, or ELEVIDYS revenue fails to inflect in the next two quarters
